decisions.text: No brand colors were supplied for MeshMedic, so the Command Center uses a neutral palette defined in one CSS token block for a later one-line swap.
Systems and guardrail statuses are treated as always-real, never toggled by sample mode — connection state and code-enforcement state are facts, not something safe to fabricate.
